Area.evidence_source: Many participants spoke of having to deal with on-going turmoil related to loss; for several participants this was traumatic and burdensome. Loss embodied different forms including loss of key relationships, support from others and bereavements. Experiences of loss had a long lasting emotional impact contributing towards feelings of despair during episodes of self-harm or suicide attempts.
